sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The game's core mechanics are simple yet addictive, making it easy to pick up and play, even for those who are new to action-packed browser games.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter increasingly tougher challenges, including new types of zombies and upgraded versions of existing ones. The game offers a wide range of upgrades, from basic firearms to advanced tools that will help you take down zombies more efficiently.

One of the game's core mechanics is the way it uses a timer to simulate the passage of time. This creates a sense of urgency, as you'll need to act quickly to survive. The game's timer also ensures that you'll never get bored, as you'll need to constantly adapt to the changing circumstances and upgrade your gear to stay ahead of the game.

In addition to its core mechanics, Zombie Hunter Survival also features a wide range of power-ups and bonuses that will help you survive longer. These can be earned through gameplay, purchased using real money, or obtained through special events and promotions. Power-ups and bonuses can range from temporary boosts to permanent upgrades, giving you an edge over the zombies and increasing your chances of survival.
